rationale: Addresses the same cluster [validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet] but through the workflow rather than the cheat sheet. The note says 'cheat-sheet clarity may be the issue' — the agent followed step 4, saw '0 errors, 0 warnings', and stopped. It never manually verified coverage that the validator cannot auto-check (alias completeness for Pattern B, item completeness for collection libraries). Adding an explicit post-validation verification instruction in step 4 closes this gap.
expected_effect: Agent will not stop at '0 warnings' for Pattern B and collection libraries. For t02-chinese-alias, it will cross-check alias completeness against source name strings. For t05-collection, it will compare source item count against extracted entity count, catching silently dropped items.
regression_risk: The added paragraph adds one manual verification step. Passing tasks (t01-id-based, t03-multi-stage, t04-external-json) may trigger the alias cross-check unnecessarily, but it is a read-only verification that will pass for well-formed packs. No structural change to the workflow order.
